name: Tsukishiro
source:
A high ranking fox spirit.
The owner of Kitsunehaku Shrine, a god in the underworld that the protagonist wandered into.
Ignoring humans feelings, he judges everything with a gods value system.
He loves interesting things, but he ignores things he doesn't like.
